maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is recurring fiber internet, TV, phone and wholesale subscriptions, not repair or replacement of customer-owned items.

publicly_funded.reason: Households and businesses pay for internet, TV, phone and wholesale services; state broadband grants only fund some network buildout.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth comes from fiber buildout (Gig City, grant-funded expansion) in its footprint; acquisitions like RRCNet are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Fiber internet, voice and wholesale carrier circuits are essential connectivity; switching means downtime and reinstallation, with few local alternatives.
